question: How much recitation must be performed after the fire oblation is completed?
premises: Recitation is prescribed after the oblation ends
The amount of recitation corresponds to the number offered
The oblations have already been completed
inference: One should chant as many times after the oblation as the number of offerings made.
plain_english: And at the end of the oblation, one should chant as many times as the number of offerings that were made.
